column1: # Rabi-Ribi (Switch, update 1.2.0 = v131072): CreSpirit's 2D engine on NVN, SDK 7.4.0; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC) + subsdk1 (movie) + sdk. No game file holds the shaders:
# main keeps 5 GLSL sources and calls glslcCompile in subsdk0, so the game compiles them with its own GLSLC at run time. The shader tables were split with this repository's
# shader_split.py from the 24 GLSLC outputs a bootstrap port saved on the device (--glslc-captures).
# Format: key <TAB> value; several values of one key are separated by spaces; comments must be on their own line
# the update NSP is v131072; the extracted version dir is v1 (display version 1.2.0 from the control data)
# the NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize (main sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region)
# a 2D platformer played with a controller; no touch or pointer input
# Run-time GLSLC outputs: a bootstrap port carries DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE in env.txt, boots the game on the device, and port again with --glslc-captures <folder> splits the tables
# from the 24 outputs it saves (every one translated). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, "Games whose shaders are compiled at run time".
